130 years of trust. One team shaping what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength.  Job role
 Our Global Pricing & Portfolio department at Allianz Commercial is seeking an experienced Power BI Developer to develop portfolio steering tools & approaches across the business, with a focus on Global Lines of Business.
You will collaborate with business users across various functions to design concepts, tools, and processes to enhance profitability understanding within Allianz Commercial’s portfolio. You will engage with stakeholders to understand their requirements and translate these into business solutions that support decision-making and drive profitability.
Furthermore, you will play an active role in Allianz Commercial’s Underwriting transformation journey by implementing advanced analytics and statistical methods, contributing to a data-driven future across the business.
 What You Will Do
Develop and optimize portfolio steering dashboards and solutions across various lines of business – including profitability analysis, target setting, KPI monitoring, and reporting – to assist Underwriting strategy and decision making.
Develop solutions based on business needs: capture data requirements from key stakeholders, translate business requirements into working code, and collaborate with business users and owners to determine which capabilities and features drive value.
Mentor business users to become self-sufficient practitioners, providing demos, training, and support to underwriters and other users.
 What You Bring
Strong experience in Front-end development using PowerBI with a strong focus on data visualization.
Experience in Azure Synapse and Databricks, including proficiency in data integration, transformation, and analytics using PySpark is a plus.
Proficiency in product design accompanied with substantial experience in data analytics and programming, demonstrating advanced analytical capabilities to analyze complex data from multiple sources; and identify and resolve issues effectively. 
Experience working within the agile development environment, adept at managing data and projects using agile methodologies."
We highly welcome candidates with a genuine interest and affinity for Information Technology (IT) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), as these attributes are considered valuable assets to our team. 
 You have
Master’s degree (or equivalent) in science or engineering, such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or Software Engineering.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, consistently revising approaches in response to new information and evolving requirements.
Strong ability to collaborate effectively with diverse team members, gathering requirements, delivering solutions, and eliciting suggestions and feedback.
Excellent English written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for varied audiences. Capable of clearly expressing ideas and messages, both written and verbally, and effectively presenting compelling narratives to audiences, whether prepared or improvised.
 What We Offer
 We support your well-being
Access dedicated counseling services, mental health resources, and well-being sessions designed to keep you feeling your best
Enjoy a personalized benefits package through a monthly budget on the Benefit platform, covering medical subscriptions, meal tickets, private pension plans, life insurance, Allianz Tiriac exclusive insurance discounts, and many more.
Prioritize what truly matters with time off on your birthday, additional vacation days for each year with Allianz (up to five extra days), Paid leave on December 24th and 31st, plus the flexibility to swap weekend holidays for extra days off, and special allowances for significant life events.
 We invest in your growth
 Take advantage of an extensive learning curriculum tailored to support your career growth and meet your professional needs, with access to a wide range of technical and soft skills trainings, international certifications (including Agile, Lean Six Sigma, PRINCE2, ITIL, IFOA, ACCA, IACCM, and more), learning resources from LinkedIn and Allianz platforms, language development opportunities (German, French, English), and our dedicated Leadership Program to help you reach the next level.
 We value you and your work
 We acknowledge and recognize your work through performance-based rewards to celebrate your achievements, team, and individual recognition programs to celebrate your contributions and internal referral bonuses.
Your personal information, including sensitive data, may be shared with Hiring Managers to evaluate your suitability for the role. Only candidates who meet the criteria will be contacted, and all applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.
